core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rashidat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Rightly guided”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rashidat corresponds to the Arabic form رَشِيدَات (Arabic root ر ش د (r-sh-d); رَشِيدَات (Rashīdāt)). Its core sense is rashidat; rightly guided (feminine). Rashidat is Arabic رَشِيدَات (Rashīdāt), the plural of رَشِيدَة (Rashīda) 'rightly guided', used as a female given name. The source gloss 'Rightly Guided' is broadly consistent.

arabic.name: رَشِيدَات
